senses.gloss:
रेखा [लिख्-अच् लस्य रः]
—1 A line, streak; मदरेखा, दानरेखा, रागरेखा &c.
—2 The measure of a line, small portion, as much as a line; न रेखामात्रमपि
 व्यतीयुः R. 1. 17.
—3 A row, range, line, series; मुदाश्रु मोक्ष्यसे क्षिप्रं मेघरेखेव वार्षिकी
 Rām. 2. 44. 27.
—4 Delineation, sketch, drawing; लावण्यरेखया किंचिदन्वितम् Ś. 6. 13.
—5 The first or prime meridian of the Indian astronomers drawn from Laṅkā
 to Meru and passing through Ujjayinī.
—6 Fulness, satisfaction.
—7 Deceit, fraud.
—8 A straight position of all limbs in dancing.
.━{@Comp.@}: रेखांशः, रेखान्तरम्, रेखाकार, रेखागणितम्, रेखान्यासः, रेखामात्रम्
रेखा + -अन्तरम् distance east or west from the first meridian, longitude of a place.
रेखा + -आकार a. lineal, formed in lines, striped.
रेखा + -न्यासः the marking down of lines.
रेखा + -मात्रम् ind. even by a line.

रेखायते Den. Ā.
—1 To praise, flatter.
—2 To vex, annoy, exasperate.
